throughline.zh: 本週涵蓋台灣晶圓與封測設備投資、東南亞電源及電子材料產線，以及 10 月 30 日公布的 ASIC 出貨、高功率電源與機櫃產能；實際進度與預估分別標示。
throughline.en: This week spans Taiwan wafer and test investments, Southeast Asian power/materials manufacturing and Oct 30 ASIC, power-system and rack-capacity updates, keeping realized operations distinct from forecasts.

title.zh: 材料、PCB 與高密度電路板擴產

summary.zh: 本週先有泰國電子材料新廠啟用與記憶體擴產規劃，華通於 10 月 30 日新增 2026 至 2028 年每年資本支出逾 200 億元的規劃，用於 mSAP 與 HDI 在台灣、泰國等地擴建。各項目仍須區分已出貨與未來產能。
summary.en: The week covered Thai electronics materials and memory expansion plans, while Compeq on October 30 described annual capex above NT$20B from 2026 to 2028 for mSAP/HDI capacity in Taiwan, Thailand and elsewhere. Existing shipments and planned capacity are separate.

title.zh: 半導體製程、廠務節電與光學測試驗證
title.en: Semiconductor process, fab power and optical testing

summary.zh: 工廠自動化與探針卡擴產提供不同產線進度，台積電 10 月 30 日另外公布外氣洗滌水泵由 10 降至 4 馬力的驗證成果；國發會規劃矽光子測試實驗室與 2027 年海外互認。單一泵浦節電率與未來實驗室認證不可等同已全面導入。
summary.en: Factory automation and probe-card expansion were reported alongside TSMC's October 30 pump retrofit validation, reducing a specific 10 hp rating to 4 hp. Taiwan also proposed silicon-photonics testing with 2027 overseas recognition; neither is system-wide commissioning.

title.zh: 伺服器電源、機櫃產能與跨境供應鏈
title.en: Server power, rack capacity and cross-border supply

summary.zh: 新加坡條件性電力進口、台達電資料中心延遲與技嘉融資均反映不同執行階段。10 月 30 日光寶科提高電源產線資本支出預算，鴻海表示 AI 機櫃產能翻倍並說明台灣、越南及北美系統整合分工，均須與實際出貨分開。
summary.en: Singapore's conditional imports, Delta's data-center delays and Gigabyte's financing had different statuses. Lite-On raised its power capex budget and Foxconn described doubled AI rack capacity and manufacturing roles across Taiwan, Vietnam and North America on October 30; output must be separated from shipments.

title.zh: 先進封裝、ASIC 與半導體測試
title.en: Advanced packaging, ASIC and semiconductor test

summary.zh: 力成與中華精測公布封裝測試實績，京元電進一步採購德州測試設備。聯發科 10 月 30 日揭露首款資料中心 ASIC 已自 9 月出貨，第四季及 2027 年營收仍為預估；日月光第三季財報需依來源分級查核。
summary.en: Powertech and CHPT reported packaging/test results and KYEC procured Texas test tooling. MediaTek on October 30 described initial ASIC shipments and forward revenue forecasts, while ASE Q3 coverage retains source qualifications.

title.zh: 晶圓資產交易、工廠投資與產業政策
title.en: Fab assets, factory investment and policy

summary.zh: 台灣晶圓廠資產交易與聯電擴產授權各有不同時程，川湖 10 月 30 日另核准高雄兩座伺服器滑軌廠 197.12 億元資本支出預算。預算核准、工程簽約與真正投產仍屬不同節點。
summary.en: Taiwan fab property transactions and UMC's capex authorization have distinct timelines, while King Slide on October 30 approved NT$19.712B for two Kaohsiung slide-rail plants. Authorizations, construction contracts and commissioning are separate milestones.
